sloka: प्लवङ्गानामनीकानि महाभ्राणीव मारुतः।स ययौ समरे तस्मिन् विधमन् रावणः शरैः ।। ६.९७.४ ।।
transliteration: plavaṅgānāmanīkāni mahābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ।sa yayau samare tasmin vidhaman rāvaṇaḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.97.4 ।।

translations.english: At that time, driven by Ravana's arrows, the Vanaras fled from the battlefield just like huge clouds are dissipated by wind.
